name: my-gas-webapp
description: A web application built with Google Apps Script, TypeScript, and ESBuild

scripts.build:server: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/Code.js --target=es2020 --platform=node --format=iife --banner:js="let _doGet, _callCustomFunction;" --footer:js="function doGet(e){ return _doGet(e); } function callCustomFunction(...args){ return _callCustomFunction.apply(this, args); }" --log-level=info
